Physical_Environment.Location: N/A (online study; participants recruited via Prolific; ethics: Ethics Committee, School of Psychology, University of Plymouth)

Equipment.Software: / (not disclosed in the paper; OSF holds only the R analysis script)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 3 (shape association: self, friend, stranger) x 2 (presentation: mixed, blocked) x 2 (trial type: matching, nonmatching), all within-subjects

Block_Structure.Block_number: 6 blocks (3 mixed + 3 blocked; block order randomized; each blocked block contains a single shape only)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 60 trials per block (360 total per participant; half matching, half nonmatching)
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 12 (before the 6 experimental blocks; not present in the data files)

Trial_Structure.SOA: 200 ms (blank interval between shape offset and label onset)
Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: sequential (shape, then 200 ms blank, then label, all centered)
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: none (self-paced; blank screen until a response)
Trial_Structure.ITI: immediate (next trial starts after the 500 ms feedback)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: triangle, square, circle (138 x 138 pixels, grey on white; shape-identity associations counterbalanced across participants and NOT recorded in the data - the Shape column holds identity words self/friend/stranger only)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: you, friend, stranger (English words; the data records the identity words self/friend/stranger)

exp2.detail: Experiment 2 (sequential shape-label matching task, Sui et al. 2014 style): 500 ms fixation, 100 ms centered shape, 200 ms blank, centered label, blank screen until response, 500 ms feedback. 30 participants recruited via Prolific (10 male, M age = 23.13, SD = 3.22); 5 participants (2 males) omitted due to excessive error rates (>50%) -> 25 analyzed. Data source: OSF 8bktn 'MoD_full_E2.csv' (8,808 rows; 25 participants x up to 360 trials = the analyzed sample only; the 5 omitted participants are not in the file). The author file already excludes RT < 200 ms trials (192 of 9,000 = 2.1% removed, matching the paper's 'approximately 2%'); library keeps the file as-is. Per-subject trial counts range 327-360 (no practice trials in the file). Column 'trialnum' = within-block index 1-60 (block number not recorded; values repeat across the 6 blocks) - kept as the Trial column in Clean. No demographics in the data; paper reports 10 male / M age 23.13 (3.22) for the 30 recruited; gender of the 25 analyzed derived as 8M/17F (5 omitted incl. 2 males) - recorded in CSV Note; subj_info rows carry '/' (no per-subject demographics available). Identity coding: shape/label identity words self/friend/stranger; standardized mapping (user decision 2026-08-31): Self / Close / Stranger. Matching: type == 'match' <-> shape == label (verified 0 mismatches across all rows). Appendix C (mean of per-subject means, RT mean (SD) and accuracy % (SD)) fully reproduced from the file (all 12 cells within +-1 ms / +-1 pp; paper Appendix A N = 8031 correct-RT observations matches the file exactly). numTrials = 360 (6 blocks x 60); Practice_Trial = 12; numBlocks = 6; Setting = Online (Prolific); Software not disclosed. Library products: raw 8,808 rows (author columns verbatim incl. trialnum), Clean 15 columns (incl. Trial), subj_info 25 rows (demographics '/'). extraIV1 = presentation order (blocked vs mixed). Task column added 2026-09 (default self-matching); study-specific extraIV columns renamed to extraIV1/extraIV2 (semantics above); redundant/derived columns removed (raw keeps originals).
